template: Purchase exactly 3 Packs of '{{v1}}' in one purchase, into the existing location '{{v3}}', with due date {{v4}}. Select the existing product by its name (do not create a product or link an unknown barcode), save the purchase once, then verify Grocy shows 3 in stock with the requested location and due date.

reportTemplate.summary: On Grocy's Purchase page I typed "{{v1}}" into the product picker and chose the existing product from its autocomplete list (no product was created and no barcode was used), set Amount = 3 (the form's disabled quantity unit showed "Pack"), Due date = {{v4}}, and left the pre-filled Location = {{v3}}, then clicked OK once. Verification from the live pages: the Stock overview now shows "{{v1}} — 3 Packs — {{v4}}", and the Stock entries report (http://127.0.0.1:8106/stockentries, Location filter "All") lists exactly ONE row: "{{v1}} | 3 Packs | {{v4}} | {{v3}}", confirming a single purchase of 3 Packs into {{v3}} with the requested due date.
